name: relay
description: Self-hosted publishing for X, Threads and TikTok. MCP server + local console.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @relay/core && npm run build -w @relay/platforms && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @relay/web
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start -w @relay/web
scripts.mcp: npm run build && npm run start -w @relay/mcp
